links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT responses to patient questions about Tommy John surgery versus recommended reading level
links.effect: Readability indices (Flesch Kincaid, Gunning Fog, SMOG, Coleman Liau, ARI) showed responses at an educational level that greatly exceeds the recommended level; no numbers given in the abstract.
links.quote: ChatGPT generated information at an educational level that greatly exceeds the recommended level.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's responses to common patient questions regarding Tommy John surgery for quality and readability without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
